scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
